question: 镇江恒顺集团每年卖出多少瓶香醋（所有的瓶装醋，不区分类型）到美国

target.what: Number of bottles of Zhenjiang Hengshun (恒顺) vinegar (all bottled vinegar types combined, excluding bulk/industrial drums) sold by Jiangsu Hengshun Vinegar-Industry Co., Ltd. into the United States market, counted as bottles shipped/sold to US customers (export shipments to US importers/distributors
target.publisher: No official publisher discloses this figure; best available proxies are Jiangsu Hengshun Vinegar-Industry Co., Ltd. annual reports (export revenue, overseas segment), China customs HS 2209 export statistics, and US import records (CBP/bill-of-lading data)
target.cadence: Annual (company annual report); monthly (China customs HS 2209); shipment-level (US import bills of lading)
target.caveats: Working interpretation: calendar year 2024 (most recent completed full year before the 2026-10-18 cutoff), bottles shipped to the US, all vinegar types, excluding bulk. Alternatives that would materially change the answer: (a) fiscal-year vs calendar-year alignment; (b) 'sold' as retail sell-through

candidates.hypothesis: Hengshun's annual report discloses total revenue, overseas/export revenue, and sometimes export volume or share; overseas revenue multiplied by a US share of exports gives US export value, which divided by average export price per bottle yields bottle count. Direction: higher overseas revenue and higher US share raise the estimate.
candidates.data_to_find: Jiangsu Hengshun Vinegar-Industry Co., Ltd. (600305.SH) annual report figures for 2022-2024: total revenue, overseas/export revenue (境外收入 or 出口收入), export volume in tons if disclosed, and any geographic breakdown (Asia/North America). Minimum evidence: overseas revenue for 2024 plus any statement of North America/US share or export tonnage.
search_hints: 恒顺醋业 2024 年报 境外收入 出口
恒顺醋业 出口 美国 销量
Jiangsu Hengshun Vinegar annual report overseas revenue export

candidates.perspective: China customs trade statistics (HS 2209 vinegar exports)
candidates.hypothesis: China's total HS 2209 vinegar exports to the US (value and quantity) bound the target from above; Hengshun's share of China's vinegar exports to the US (from company export share or brand concentration) times that total gives Hengshun US volume. Direction: larger US-bound HS 2209 volume or larger Hengshun share raises the estimate.
candidates.data_to_find: China customs (GACC) or UN Comtrade HS 2209 exports from China to USA for 2023-2024: value in USD and net weight in kg, plus number of exporters if available. Also Hengshun's share of China's vinegar exports (company statements or industry reports). Substitute: HS 220900 export totals to North America.
search_hints: China customs HS 2209 vinegar exports United States 2024
中国 醋 出口 美国 海关 2209
UN Comtrade vinegar 2209 China USA

candidates.perspective: US import records / bill of lading data
candidates.hypothesis: US CBP import manifests and commercial bill-of-lading databases (Panjiva, ImportGenius, ImportYeti) list shipments consigned to US importers from Hengshun; summing shipment weights/units over 2024 and converting to bottles gives a direct physical-flow estimate. Direction: more recorded shipments/containers raise the estimate.
candidates.data_to_find: 2024 US import shipment records naming Jiangsu Hengshun Vinegar-Industry Co. or Hengshun as shipper: number of shipments, container counts, declared weight (kg) and/or unit counts, HS 2209. Minimum evidence: total declared weight or bottle counts for 2024; substitute: number of 20ft containers times typical payload.
search_hints: Hengshun vinegar bill of lading US import
ImportYeti Hengshun vinegar
Panjiva Jiangsu Hengshun Vinegar shipments USA

candidates.perspective: US retail/ethnic-grocery channel and consumer demand
candidates.hypothesis: US retail sales of Hengshun/Chinkiang vinegar in Asian supermarkets and online (Weee!, Amazon) times Hengshun's brand share of that category gives US sell-through in bottles; this approximates shipments over a year if inventories are stable. Direction: higher category sales or brand share raises the estimate.
candidates.data_to_find: US retail sales volume/value of Chinkiang/black vinegar (Nielsen/SPINS/Statista or trade press), Hengshun's brand share within it, and typical bottle size (500 ml). Minimum evidence: US black-vinegar category size and Hengshun share; substitute: Amazon/Weee! sales-rank-based estimates.

black vinegar US sales Nielsen

candidates.hypothesis: Export value per bottle (FOB price) converts any revenue or value figure into bottle counts; average export price per 500 ml bottle of Hengshun vinegar can be derived from retail price minus margins or from customs unit values. Direction: lower price per bottle yields more bottles for a given value.
candidates.data_to_find: Hengshun vinegar export FOB price per bottle or per ton (company disclosures, Alibaba export listings, customs unit value USD/kg for HS 2209 China-to-US), and typical bottle net weight (500 ml ≈ 0.5 kg). Minimum evidence: one credible unit value for 2024.
search_hints: Hengshun vinegar export price per bottle FOB
Chinkiang vinegar wholesale price USA case
HS 2209 unit value China export USD per kg

candidates.perspective: US importer/distributor and Chinese export agent
candidates.hypothesis: US distributors of Chinese condiments (e.g., Weee!, JFC, importer listings) and Hengshun's export agents may disclose annual container volumes or sales; these statements constrain shipment counts. Direction: disclosed container volumes directly scale bottle counts.
candidates.data_to_find: Statements or profiles of US importers/distributors of Hengshun vinegar giving annual container or case volumes; Hengshun export department interviews mentioning US orders. Minimum evidence: one annual volume figure or container count for the US.

candidates.hypothesis: US tariffs on Chinese food products (Section 301) and shipping-cost shocks change Hengshun's US export volumes year to year; identifying 2024-specific tariff/price effects adjusts a base-year volume. Direction: tariff increases or freight spikes reduce 2024 US shipments relative to trend.
candidates.data_to_find: US tariff rates on HS 2209 Chinese vinegar in 2024, freight rate indices China-US 2024, and any reported export-volume impact for Chinese condiment exporters. Minimum evidence: tariff status and any volume-impact commentary.

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
